name: JoAi: Update Element Variation

description.en: Update an element variation's label, aspect ratio, or spec overrides.
description.de: Aktualisiere das Label, das Seitenverhältnis oder die Spec-Überschreibungen einer Element-Variation.
description.es: Update an element variation's label, aspect ratio, or spec overrides.
description.fr: Update an element variation's label, aspect ratio, or spec overrides.
description.ro: Update an element variation's label, aspect ratio, or spec overrides.
description.it: Update an element variation's label, aspect ratio, or spec overrides.

bot: Use this when the user wants to relabel a variation or change its aspect ratio. Use list_element_variations first to find variation IDs.

inputs.name: Element ID

description.en: The ID of the parent element
description.es: The ID of the parent element
description.fr: The ID of the parent element
description.ro: The ID of the parent element
description.it: The ID of the parent element

inputs.bot: The element hash ID this variation belongs to.

inputs.name: Variation ID

description.en: The ID of the variation to update
description.de: Die ID der zu aktualisierenden Variation
description.es: The ID of the variation to update
description.fr: The ID of the variation to update
description.ro: The ID of the variation to update
description.it: The ID of the variation to update

inputs.bot: The variation hash ID. Use list_element_variations to find IDs.

inputs.name: Label
inputs.bot: An optional new label, e.g. 'Dark moody', 'Outdoor scene'.

inputs.name: Aspect Ratio
inputs.bot: Optional aspect ratio for the variation images.

inputs.name: Overrides

description.en: Definition overrides for this variation as JSON
description.de: Definitions-Überschreibungen für diese Variation als JSON
description.es: Sustituciones de la definición para esta variación como JSON
description.fr: Remplacements de définition pour cette variation au format JSON
description.ro: Suprascrieri ale definiției pentru această variație ca JSON
description.it: Sostituzioni della definizione per questa variazione come JSON

inputs.bot: Optional JSON object merged over the element spec for this variation only. For template elements, e.g. a different size or root tree.

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.de: Team-Slug für diese Aktion. Standardmäßig das aktuelle Team.
description.es: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.fr: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.ro: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.it: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.

inputs.bot: The slug of the team to operate on. Omit to use the current team.
